L1.name: System Prompt
L1.description: Immutable constitution governing agent behavior, safety, and reasoning.

L2.name: Active Policy
L2.description: Dynamic business rules for returns, windows, caps, and restocking fees.

L3.name: Tool Results / Database
L3.description: Ground truth state for orders, deliveries, payments, and tickets.

decisions.name: ANSWER
decisions.criteria: Clear informational inquiry, facts verified, zero policy violation.

decisions.name: ASK
decisions.criteria: Missing order ID, multiple candidate orders, missing photo, or unclear reason. Max 1 question.

decisions.name: ACT
decisions.criteria: Claims verified against DB, eligible under active policy, within auto-approval cap, zero risk flags.

decisions.name: ESCALATE
decisions.criteria: Legal/safety threats, OTP-verified non-delivery dispute, amount > cap, repeated refund history, account mismatch.
